# unifi_network_wan_network_group (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi WAN network group (e.g. `WAN`, `WAN2`) by name (`wan/networkgroups`, v2). WAN groups are derived from the WAN networks the gateway has; this reads their load-balancing role and binding.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) WAN network group name to look up (e.g. `WAN`, `WAN2`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) WAN network group id (e.g. `WAN`, `WAN2`).
- `is_mobile_broadband` (Boolean) Whether this WAN is a mobile-broadband (cellular) link.
- `load_balancing_mode` (String) Load-balancing role of this WAN (e.g. failover/weighted).
- `network_id` (String) `_id` of the bound WAN network (networkconf).
- `priority` (Number) Failover priority.
- `wan_magic_enabled` (Boolean) Whether WAN Magic is enabled on this WAN.
